newsitem.title: USA: ABC Dispensing to stay on Nasdaq SmallCap.
newsitem.headline: ABC Dispensing to stay on Nasdaq SmallCap.

text.p: ABC Dispensing Technologies Inc said on Friday its common stock would remain listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap because it was exempted from the requirements on capital, surplus and minimum bid price.
When the company failed to meet these requirements in July and November, it was granted a temporary exemption by Nasdaq, subject to ABC meeting certain conditions.
"ABC's financial condition is improving as a result of new equity that is in the process of being invested in our company," Chief Executive Officer and President Charles Stimac Jr. said.

"In addition, we are confident that the recent implementation of new marketing management and intensified sales efforts will result in an increasing revenue stream and positive earnings in the coming year," he said.
The company said while it believed it could meet these conditions, there were no assurances.
